ops.reason.parse: The edit is not valid JSON or has a wrong shape.
ops.reason.version: The edit was written for another format version.
ops.reason.duplicate_group: Two groups have the same id.
ops.reason.duplicate_slot: Two operations create the same slot.
ops.reason.bad_dependency: A group depends on a group that does not come before it.
ops.reason.unknown_slot: An operation uses a slot that no earlier operation creates.
ops.reason.undeclared_dependency: An operation uses a slot of a group it does not depend on.
ops.reason.unsupported: This change is not supported for the element.
ops.reason.parallel: The lines are parallel and do not meet.
ops.reason.not_parallel: The edge is not parallel to the reference.
ops.reason.bad_count: The count must be at least 2.
ops.reason.degenerate: The result would be degenerate (zero size or self-intersecting).
ops.reason.outside_host: The element would fall outside its host.
ops.reason.off_host: The point is not on the host.
ops.reason.out_of_range: The value is out of the allowed range.
ops.reason.non_finite: A value is not a finite number.
ops.reason.bad_part: Unknown part name. Use face:left, face:right, face:top, edge:N, axis, end:a, end:b, mid or centre.
ops.reason.too_many: The result would have too many parts.
ops.reason.referenced: The element is still used by other elements.
ops.reason.newer_file: The file was saved by a newer version.
ops.reason.internal: Internal error; the model was not changed.
